us/af_heart/e2/e230f958eb0229f0.mp3.texto: On weekdays, I get up at six o'clock. First, I take a shower and get dressed. Then I have breakfast with my husband: coffee, eggs and fruit. I leave home at a quarter past seven and take the bus to work. I work in an office from eight to four, and I have lunch at one with my coworkers. After that, I go home and cook dinner. In the evening, I read or watch TV. Finally, I go to bed at half past ten. My husband's routine is very different. He works at night, so he gets up at noon. He has breakfast at one o'clock, and he leaves home at five.

us/af_heart/d0/d084985a59bfa798.mp3.texto: My ideal weekend is quiet and simple. On Saturday, I never get up early: I usually wake up at nine. I love having a big breakfast with my family. After breakfast, we often go to the park, and my kids play soccer. I hate staying at home all day! On Saturday night, I sometimes go to the movies with friends. On Sunday, I always visit my parents. My mom cooks, and I help her in the kitchen. I go swimming twice a month, and I clean the house once a week, but I don't like cleaning! On Sunday evening, I'm usually tired, so I read a book or watch a series.

He has breakfast at one o'clock, and he leaves home at five.
